notes: Chests give bonus items more often: RP pouch, Quest reroll, Streak Restore or a rare 2x boost. Better chests, better items
2x boost now comes only from chests (30 min to 2 h) and waits on Home: activate it within 24 hours when you're about to walk
Reroll a daily quest you don't like: once a day free, more with Quest rerolls from chests
Finish all 3 quests for a bonus: +30 RP a day, +100 RP a week
New any-time quests: Power hour and Active hours. No more "before 10:00" deadlines
Quests get harder at higher ranks and pay more RP; goal quests and streak rewards grow with your daily goal
A ranked challenge you missed just expires, no RP lost. Only a started challenge you don't finish costs RP
Invites give RP: +100 for you, +50 for your friend
Fixed progress sometimes being undone after the tutorial or a settings change
